item.title: Thomas Kaufmann: Keeping Alabama's historic lookout towers
item.description: After Smokey Bear, historic lookout towers are the most recognized symbols of the forest service, and at one time, over 200 of these artifacts dotted Alabama.Made of wood and steel, these tall, commanding structures were marvels of engineering for their time and helped keep Alabama safe from forest fires – even in urban areas permeated and surrounded by forests of green.
